name: g10: walking ground under the two small tents the owner turned by the bank, out of their mouths to the open ground, so Chee-jeem and Ee-wulm reach their bedrolls (the tents cut the mesh under their canvas)

walk.note: the floor of the small tent by the bank where Chee-jeem sleeps, walked out east of its mouth to the open ground: the tent cut the mesh under its canvas

before.note: the floor of the east small tent, where Chee-jeem sleeps, walked out to the open ground south of it: the mesh was cut away under its canvas when its ground was levelled

walk.note: the floor of the second small tent by the bank where Ee-wulm sleeps, walked out east of its mouth to the open ground: the tent cut the mesh under its canvas
